failure_modes.lesson: Few indexed sellers can hide deep B2B/dealer distribution.
failure_modes.control: Count GOOD sellers and check authorized distributor/channel depth.

failure_modes.lesson: Weak comparison content can coexist with plentiful stock.

failure_modes.control: Require dealer net cost, freight, VAT/duty treatment, payment, returns, warranty and support reserves.

failure_modes.lesson: Without CPC and contribution, a small ad test is not interpretable.
failure_modes.control: Keyword Planner + economics are hard gates before paid media.

failure_modes.lesson: Waiting cost, shipping cost, returns and trust destroy value in wealthy localized markets.
failure_modes.control: Prefer Nordic/EU stock and truthful ETA; use China-direct only when quantified economics overcome friction.

failure_modes.lesson: Translated copy alone does not create trust.
failure_modes.control: Native decision support, local checkout, delivery choice, tax transparency, warranty and real company identity.

failure_modes.lesson: Revenue/ROAS can hide negative unit economics.
failure_modes.control: Optimize realized contribution by SKU/query after all variable reserves.

failure_modes.lesson: Bad ATC/checkout events cause false optimization.
Stockout/SKU merge/feed failures can erase demand capture.
failure_modes.control: Track stock reliability, feed changes and supplier anomalies; pause affected SKUs.
Add structural-demand and replacement-cycle evidence where possible.

failure_modes.name: Point-in-time leakage
failure_modes.description: Historical strategy used evidence unavailable at decision time.

failure_modes.name: Winner-only learning
failure_modes.description: Only successful/launched candidates retained; rejected/failed universe disappears.

failure_modes.name: Installed-base definition collapse
failure_modes.description: Different official concepts silently combined into one stock estimate.

failure_modes.name: Hidden B2B/dealer competition
failure_modes.description: Search whitespace mistaken for market whitespace when distributors/installers operate behind login/account channels.

failure_modes.name: Source-market cargo cult
failure_modes.description: Copying a mature-market merchant without verifying target demand/preferences/economics.
prevention: source proof separated from target proof

failure_modes.name: Seed query treated as measured demand
failure_modes.description: LLM/native phrasing is mistaken for search evidence.

failure_modes.name: Broad HS/CN code overclaim
failure_modes.description: Import growth in broad commodity code interpreted as exact product demand.
